title: Paneled token morphology and delta-spec for forms and cards
creator: Ava Morales
description:
Goal: define a 'paneled' set of semantic tokens and a delta-spec that normalizes surface, type, spacing, radius, and elevation across form and card-like components. This ticket delivers the design spec, accessibility checks, alias/deprecation map, and migration guidance for front-end engineers and platform infra. The purpose is to reduce token surface area, create proportional spacing utilities appropriate for dense UIs, and replace ad-hoc shadow presets with a physically scaled elevation system.

Scope: forms, cards, small panels (e.g., popovers, settings rows), and compact data surfaces used in dashboards. Excludes charts and iconography tokens (handled separately).

Deliverables:
- Paneled token spec (semantic colors for background/foreground/border/interactive states).
- Typography adjustments for compact hierarchies (label, body-compact, subheading).
- Proportional spacing and radius utilities (space-* mapped to base scale, token deltas for compact vs default).
- Physical elevation & shadow matrix with tokenized variables and high-contrast accessibility variants.
- Complete delta-spec mapping old tokens -> new tokens + deprecation timeline.
- Migration guide with sample codemods and CSS variable aliases.
- Acceptance criteria, test checklist, and PR templates for engineers.
acceptance_criteria: Design spec contains a complete list of new paneled semantic tokens and their intended usage contexts (background, surface, border, elevated surface, interactive).
Delta-spec csv mapping at least 95% of in-repo token references to new tokens with clear aliases for remaining cases.
Typography scale includes compact variants with explicit line-height, letter-spacing, and token names used in code (e.g., type-compact-body-14).
Spacing utilities defined as proportional tokens (space-xs -> 4px, space-sm -> 8px, etc.) and a migration note for components using hard-coded paddings/margins.
Elevation matrix documented with visual examples at 1x, 2x device pixel density and accessibility-aware variants for high-contrast mode.
Design review and accessibility pass completed: contrast ratios and touch target radius checks documented.
Draft migration codemod and sample PR linked; at least one component (Card) migrated in a demo PR for engineering review.
tasks: Inventory existing tokens used by forms/cards across repo (survey scripts + sample queries)
Prototype paneled token palettes and get accessibility contrast sign-off
Define compact typography tokens and produce visual spec artifacts
Design proportional spacing and radius token set and run touch-target analysis
Create elevation/shadow matrix with physical metrics and CSS variables
Produce delta-spec CSV mapping old_token -> new_token and mark deprecation windows
Write migration guide and codemod examples; open demo PR migrating /components/Card
Coordinate with engineering to estimate runtime impact and console rollout plan
comments: 2026-03-01 - Ava Morales: Created ticket. Initial scoping workshop completed with PM and two engineers. Decided to isolate paneled surfaces to forms/cards for first wave to minimize blast radius.
2026-03-04 - Rishi Patel: Ran repository token inventory. Found ~128 unique surface/border tokens across components; ~22 appear exclusively in legacy widgets. Will produce delta-spec by 2026-03-08.

2026-03-07 - Design Review: Prototype panels shown in Figma. Feedback: increase neutral-500 contrast on elevated surfaces in high-contrast mode; reduce micro-shadow blur for small cards to avoid halo on dark backgrounds.
2026-03-09 - Accessibility: Ran contrast checks; three state colors failed for small text on compact surfaces. Action: revise token palette and add semantic 'surface-emphasis' variants.

2026-03-11 - Engineering (J. Lee): Reviewed elevation tokenization approach. Concern about runtime cost of too many CSS variables on SSR pages. Proposal: bundle default tokens into runtime CSS, lazy-load compact token overrides.
2026-03-12 - Rishi Patel: Uploaded delta-spec CSV to Confluence and opened demo PR migrating components/Card. Requesting design approval on final radius and compact type tokens before merging.
